name: io.github.amosgeva/portfoliodb
title: PortfolioDB
description: Read-only queries over your own append-only portfolio ledger on Postgres.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer {PORTFOLIODB_MCP_TOKEN} — the token from your .env, generated by `make init`.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shared bearer token every MCP request must present. `make init` generates one.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the application's Postgres user. This server needs its own database — it reads your ledger, it does not host one.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Postgres host. Inside the shipped docker-compose network this is `postgres`.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_MCP_RO_USER
environmentVariables.description: Optional SELECT-only Postgres role for this server to use instead of the application user. Create it with `make ro-role`.

environmentVariables.name: PORTFOLIODB_MCP_RO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the SELECT-only role above.
